nonblocking_notes.failure_case: Mutable major-tag CI actions can execute changed upstream code without a repository diff, despite application lockfiles.
nonblocking_notes.resolution: Pin reviewed GitHub Action implementations by full commit SHA, preserve version comments and update them through review before expanding CI authority or distribution.

nonblocking_notes.failure_case: The combined S1/S3 artifact gate row could be read as postponing its cross-tenant access and URL-expiry tests until managed cleanup, even if team artifact endpoints are introduced in S2.
nonblocking_notes.resolution: Apply the already-required R04/R18 authorization tests at the first S2 artifact API exposure; leave managed cleanup/restore cases at their later applicable gate.
